decisions_requested.statement: Preserve VANUVALI and VANI as source-observation forms outside active L02 teaching vocabulary until their semantics are recovered or explicitly governed.
Approve HABITUALITY_EVERY_DAY as an L02 semantic need and authorize SARU (LEX-018, WATCH) for later scoped L02 curriculum rebind review.
Approve DESTINATION_PURPOSE as an L02 semantic need and authorize TA (LEX-019, CANDIDATE) for later scoped L02 curriculum rebind review.
Confirm that SARU/TA do not historically replace or explain VANUVALI/VANI; they are independent governed curriculum reuses selected for L02 pedagogical needs.
Keep all L02 sentence grammar, OPI, Story, QA, Activation and Review authoring on HOLD until this two-slot policy and a scoped microgrammar are approved.
